meeting.description: 開始一段持續到您手動停止的錄音。它將連同轉錄文字一起儲存到歷史紀錄。

meeting.retentionDescription: 已結束的會議保留多久。超過所選期限的會議會被永久刪除--音訊、逐字稿和筆記一起--在 FlowState 啟動時以及執行期間每天一次。聽寫不受影響。

meeting.systemAudioDescription: 會議也會錄下機器本身播放的聲音--Zoom 或 Teams 通話中對方的聲音--作為麥克風旁的第二條音軌，並依時間戳記合併進逐字稿。一切都在本機錄製，不需要任何權限對話框，永遠不會離開這部裝置。

about.tagline: Dictation that never leaves your machine.

enabled.title: Sync on
enabled.description: Keep the dictionary, snippets and (optionally) history the same on your own Macs - no account, no cloud server.

explain.offline: Everything is plain file copy through a folder you pick (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or a USB stick), so it works offline and on school networks where machines cannot reach each other.
explain.off: Turning sync off stops everything: nothing is published, nothing is merged, nothing is written.

folder.title: Shared folder
folder.description: The folder both Macs can see. FlowState writes a small "FlowState Sync" subfolder into it.

history.title: Include history
history.description: Also sync history entries with their audio. Sync never deletes history.

bundle.title: FlowState bundle
bundle.description: A sealed zip you can hand to your other Mac (AirDrop, USB) when there is no shared folder yet.
bundle.sealed: Every file inside is checksummed and the manifest is sealed; a damaged or tampered bundle is refused without touching your data.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.description: When both Macs changed the same entry, both versions survive and the collision is logged here. Nothing is ever silently lost.

toasts.doneWithConflicts: Synced with {{count}} conflict(s) - both versions were kept, see the conflict log
toasts.importedConflicts: {{count}} conflict(s) while importing - both versions were kept
